about_short_description.short_description: LaunchDarkly is a feature management platform that allows software development teams to deliver to their customers.

product.name: Feature Flags
product.description: A system to control software feature releases by toggling features on or off in real time without redeploying code.

product.name: Release Automation
product.description: A tool to monitor software releases, detect performance issues, and automatically remediate problems before they affect customers.

product.name: Experimentation & Analytics
product.description: A platform to run A/B tests and multivariate experiments, analyze feature performance, and optimize product decisions based on data.

product.name: AI Engineering
product.description: A service to manage and iterate AI model configurations and prompts in production without redeploying applications.

product.name: Application Readiness Professional Services
product.description: Consulting and implementation services to help organizations integrate LaunchDarkly SDKs and adopt feature management best practices.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: A suite of connectors and plugins that link LaunchDarkly with third-party tools for development, collaboration, analytics, and deployment.
